upload.title: 사직서를 지갑에 넣고 출근하는 아빠 | 여섯 시 사십 분 #shorts
upload.description:
그만둘까, 백 번을 써 둔 사직서.
그 위로 아이들 웃는 사진 한 장.

매일 아침 바위를 밀어 올리는 시시포스처럼,
우리는 오늘도 출근합니다.

🎵 여섯 시 사십 분 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 당신의 출근 시간은 몇 시인가요? 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

#출근 #직장인 #아빠 #가장 #위로 #직장인공감 #출근송 #MIDLIFECOMMUTER #shorts

scenes.plate: the entrance hallway of a small Korean apartment before dawn, deep blue light through a small window, a shoe rack and a front door, quiet and still
scenes.motion: the tired man lets out a slow sigh, his shoulders rise and fall, he glances at the front door, the small ceiling lamp glows softly

scenes.plate: a dim apartment hallway before dawn lit by one small warm wall lamp, a coat hanger and a mirror, cozy but tired mood
scenes.motion: the man looks down at the old wallet in his hands, gently touches a folded letter inside, then closes the wallet with a small sad smile

scenes.plate: a cozy Korean apartment living room at dawn, soft warm lamp light, framed family photos and children's drawings on the wall, toys on the floor
scenes.motion: the two children wave and giggle at their father, the man smiles back warmly and nods, warm lamp light

scenes.plate: the elevator lobby of a Korean apartment building at dawn, steel elevator doors, cool blue morning light, clean tiled floor
scenes.motion: the man walks forward through the quiet lobby with his briefcase, the elevator doors slowly close behind him, cool morning light

scenes.plate: a busy Seoul subway platform in the early morning, a big digital clock on the wall showing 6:40, blue morning light, platform screen doors
scenes.extras: many sleepy commuters in winter coats standing in a line along the platform on both sides, a young woman with earphones, an old man with a cap
scenes.motion: the man walks along the busy platform among the commuters, a subway train slides into the station behind the screen doors, people shift and wait

scenes.plate: a steep narrow uphill street in a modern Korean hillside neighbourhood (dal-dongne) at sunrise, two and three storey concrete and red-brick houses with flat roofs and blue rooftop water tanks, tangled power lines and utility poles, small Korean shop signs, the road climbing toward a golden sky
scenes.extras: a street sweeper in an orange vest far up the hill, an old woman walking down with a shopping bag
scenes.motion: the man walks slowly up the steep street away from the camera, far ahead an old woman walks down with her shopping bag, the morning light grows warmer

scenes.plate: interior of a Seoul metro subway car in the morning, long continuous bench seats running along both side walls facing each other across the aisle, rows of hand straps and metal poles, sliding doors, route map above the windows, warm golden sunlight through the windows
scenes.extras: commuters seated shoulder to shoulder on both side benches, some dozing, some looking at phones, a few office workers standing and holding hand straps
scenes.motion: the subway car sways gently as it moves, sunlight flickers across the seated passengers, the man stands in the aisle holding his briefcase and smiles softly to himself

scenes.plate: a long outdoor stone staircase climbing up a hill in a quiet Korean neighbourhood at sunrise, small houses on both sides, a glowing golden sky at the top of the stairs
scenes.motion: at the top of the stairs his wife and children wave to him happily, the man looks up at them and starts to climb, golden sunrise light

scenes.plate: a wide Seoul crosswalk in the morning rush hour, tall office towers, golden morning light, zebra crossing stripes
scenes.extras: a crowd of commuters crossing, a grandfather with a cane, a student with a backpack
scenes.motion: the crowd crosses the zebra crossing around the man as he walks briskly forward, cars wait at the light, busy morning

scenes.plate: a busy Seoul office building entrance in the morning, glass doors and warm sunlight, a few potted plants, hopeful start of the day
scenes.motion: the young colleague greets the man with a cheerful bow, the man smiles and pats his shoulder, the glass doors open behind them

scenes.plate: a city street at sunrise, the road leading toward a bright golden rising sun between office buildings, warm hopeful mood
scenes.extras: people walking to work along the street
scenes.motion: the man walks away toward the bright rising sun down the street, people walk to work around him
